Lions vs Vikings Betting History

The Detroit Lions and Minnesota Vikings have met 119 times since the 1966 season. The Vikings lead the series 80-38-1. Against the closing spread the Lions are 55-59-5 (Vikings 59-55-5), and the over is 44-48-1 in meetings with a closing total. Last meeting: Dec 25, 2025, Vikings 23-10.
